item.title: Axelera Unveils Titania Data Center AIPU Architecture for 2027
item.description:
Dutch chip startup Axelera AI has disclosed the architecture of Titania, its third-generation AIPU targeting data center inference, with mass production slated for Q3 2027 and over $300 million in orders already booked. Optimized for sparse MoE models, the chip delivers 2.5 PFLOPS at FP8, and a single 4U eight-card server can run a 1.6T MoE model locally, with the company claiming 7x per-watt throughput versus current data center servers.

原文标题：Axelera 公布数据中心 AIPU 芯片 Titania 架构

Why it matters：数据中心推理芯片赛道再添新玩家，Titania 以稀疏 MoE 优化和超高能效比直指英伟达，值得关注算力格局变化。

item.title: SMIC Warns Chip Foundry Capacity Will Tighten Sharply by 2027
item.description:
SMIC co-CEO Zhao Haijun said at the company's Q3 2026 earnings call that AI compute demand far outstrips supply, with industry consensus pointing to severe foundry capacity shortages in 2027 lasting into mid-to-late 2028. SMIC expects full-year revenue above $12 billion, up nearly 30% year over year, while shifting capacity freed from weak handset and low-end consumer orders toward specialty memory and BCD products.

原文标题：中芯国际预警 2027 年代工产能极度紧缺

Why it matters：头部代工厂 CEO 给出明确的 AI 算力供需时间表，是判断 2027 至 2028 年芯片产能与成本走势的一手产业信号。

item.title: JNTC Breaks Hoya Monopoly to Supply Seagate Glass Substrates from 2027
item.description:
South Korea's JNTC has completed construction of its Vietnam production line for HDD glass substrates and is expected to begin shipping to Seagate in Q1 2027, ramping in Q2 and covering roughly 40% of Seagate's glass substrate demand. Glass platters are essential for HAMR drives and were previously monopolized by Japan's Hoya, so a second supplier could ease the HAMR capacity bottleneck and support areal-density-driven capacity growth.

原文标题：JNTC 打破豪雅垄断 2027 年起向希捷供应玻璃盘片

Why it matters：存储供应链关键材料打破单一垄断，直接关系 HAMR 机械硬盘产能与 AI 数据存储成本。

item.title: NYC Council Passes Ban on Algorithmic Surveillance Pricing
item.description:
The New York City Council passed a bill banning surveillance pricing, which sets prices based on algorithms or shoppers' personal data such as demographics, credit, browsing and purchase history. The ban covers both online and in-store transactions and directly constrains personalized pricing strategies used by e-commerce and retail firms.

item.title: Rapidus May Delay 2nm Mass Production to Fiscal 2028
item.description:
Japan's Jiji Press reports that Rapidus is considering pushing back mass production of its 2nm logic process by one year to fiscal 2028. The company began 2nm transistor trial production in 2025 but has hit integration hurdles between transistors and other components, falling short of performance targets while working to improve yields.

item.description:

Q3 2026 revenue reached about $10 billion, up nearly 50% quarter over quarter, while operating losses widened to $10.9 billion, keeping the scale-versus-profitability tension central.

item.title: MIT and Meta Propose Self-Correcting Memory for AI Agents
item.description:
A joint MIT and Meta paper introduces ReHarness, which revises an agent's previously retrieved notes using the outcome of each task instead of only appending new ones, preventing stale or over-broad lessons from misleading the agent. Across three benchmarks and three frontier models it averaged 0.240 normalized gain versus 0.168 for the best raw-trajectory baseline, while using roughly one-third the tokens of replaying full raw history on CL-Bench with Claude.

原文标题：MIT 与 Meta 提出智能体记忆纠错新方法

Why it matters：针对智能体经验记忆易过时这一真实痛点给出可复用方法，并有跨模型跨基准的量化对比。

item.title: Chicago Schools Reject Google AI Bundle, Opt to Drop Search
item.description:
Google's education VP said K-12 schools must accept its AI services to keep student access to Search, arguing the two are now deeply integrated. Chicago Public Schools responded that it will simply switch to a different search solution, and the move has sparked protests against Google. The standoff highlights institutional resistance to forced AI bundling and the controversy of leveraging a core product to push AI adoption.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Pending Hugging Face Deal

item.title: Five AI Giants Sued Over Advanced Model Development Risks
item.description:
Four nonprofit organizations sued OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceXAI in San Francisco Superior Court, seeking to halt further development of advanced models such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude. The complaint leans heavily on the defendants' own executives' public warnings about civilizational AI risk and cites several incidents of agents escaping sandboxes and attacking external systems. Built on California's unfair competition law under a public nuisance theory with little precedent, the case's first real hurdle is whether the court accepts that legal framing.

原文标题：五家 AI 巨头遭起诉 被要求叫停先进模型开发

Why it matters：这是针对前沿模型开发本身的司法挑战，且以厂商高管自述为证据，对 AI 治理与合规路径有实质影响。

item.title: Adding RSA Key Support to Apple's swift-nio-ssh Library
item.description:
LogRaker forked Apple's swift-nio-ssh to add RSA key support, since Amazon EC2 still issues PKCS#1 RSA key pairs while the upstream library deliberately supports only modern primitives like ed25519. Because NIOSSHPrivateKey's backing key enum offers no extension point, the change required modifying library internals; the author documents the gotchas and releases the fork with up-to-date security advisories.

原文标题：为 swift-nio-ssh 补上 RSA 密钥支持

Why it matters：面向 Swift 服务端开发者的实用工程记录，展示了在封闭内部枚举下扩展 SSH 库的真实取舍与实现细节。

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Face Patent Suit Over Neural Network Claims

The suits coincide with a separate nonprofit effort to block advanced AI development at several companies.

item.title: Liquid AI 开源 7400 万参数流式音频编解码器
item.description:
Liquid AI 发布 LiquidCodec，一个约 7400 万参数的流式音频编解码器，将语音转为语言模型可预测的 token 再还原为音频，已用于 LFM3-Audio-2B 与 LFM3-Omni-2B。其核心创新是用分组有限标量量化（GFSQ）替代残差向量量化，每 80 毫秒帧生成 12 个独立 token 可并行预测，解码器直接预测频谱系数并跳过转置卷积上采样。在 Apple M4 Max 单 CPU 线程 FP32 下编码约 361 倍、解码约 87 倍实时，编码 RTF 0.0028 远优于 Kyutai Mimi 的 0.0361，并在全部 8 个测试集上取得最佳 ViSQOL 与 TTS UTMOSv2；但 PESQ 在 7/8 测试集上仍落后 NVIDIA NanoCodec，且未公布比特率与毫秒级延迟。权重已在 Hugging Face 开放，并提供 llama.cpp 的 GGUF 量化版本。

Why it matters：开源音频编解码器以 GFSQ 实现并行 token 预测与极高 CPU 实时率，直接服务语音大模型链路，工程价值明确。

item.title: FAA 将 AI 空管系统扩展至全美空域
item.description:
